subject: v1.1 (Phase 14 task 14.2) release build, reproducible artifact, and release documentation
scope: reproducibility evidence and test-claim honesty for the v1.1 release artifact

findings.summary: The release docs misstate which facts the host-guarded run unskips and what its 44 remaining skips are; 43 of the 44 are ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT-gated native facts, not the non-canonical cross-runtime golden set.
findings.description: docs/release/build-and-release.md:87-90 says the host-guarded run unskips 'the pinned-host route, discovery, native-Skia, and package-content facts' and that 'the remaining 44 skips are the pre-existing non-canonical cross-runtime golden set'. docs/limitations.md V6 (lines 310-318) likewise says the four fact categories skip unless ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is set and that 'the skips are the environment-guarded pinned-host facts and the pre-existing non-canonical cross-runtime golden set'. Independent TRX skip capture from this run shows the host-guarded 44 skips are: 39 x SkiaNativeFact ('Set ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 ...'), 4 x SkiaNativeTheory ('Set ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 ... golden and cross-runtime fixtures'), and exactly 1 x NonCanonicalRuntimeFact ('Set ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS=1'). No native-Skia fact unskips with ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR; the 19 facts that unskip are exclusively JellyfinHostFact-gated. The counts themselves (1494/63, 1513/44, 1575/20) are all accurate and reproduced. This is newly-introduced prose (the previous limitations.md wording applied the 'pinned-host + non-canonical' phrase to the forced-native run's 20 remaining skips, where it was correct; the 14.2 edit generalized it to the host-guarded 44). It materially misleads a release reader about which run exercises native rendering, although the forced-native run and the ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT guard are documented elsewhere in the same file. The implementation-reviewer already recorded this as LOW informational finding 14.2-R1; this reviewer independently reproduces the exact skip set and rates it MEDIUM as a release-doc coverage statement, not a count error.
evidence: default.trx / host.trx / native.trx skip messages: host.trx has 39 SkiaNativeFact + 4 SkiaNativeTheory + 1 NonCanonicalRuntimeFact = 44
native.trx has 19 JellyfinHostFact + 1 NonCanonicalRuntimeFact = 20 (confirms the old forced-native phrasing was correct)
findings.recommended_action: Reword both passages to match the guards: only the pinned-host route/response, discovery, dashboard, and configuration facts unskip with ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR; the 44 remaining host-guarded skips are the 43 ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT-gated native-render/decode facts (39 facts + 4 theory cases) plus the single ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS-gated cross-runtime comparison. Non-blocking for task 14.2's reproducibility acceptance criterion.

findings.summary: The recorded default suite count (Passed 1,494 / Skipped 63) is state-dependent: it holds only when artifacts/ArrTags_*.zip already exists; a clean checkout yields Passed 1,491 / Skipped 66.
findings.description: The 3 PackagedPluginFact package-content tests run only when a built archive is present (PackagedPluginFactAttribute skips otherwise). The documented default figure of 1494/63/1557 was produced with a pre-existing artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip; independently re-running the default suite with the archive present reproduces 1494/63/1557, but with the archive removed it is 1491/66/1557 (same Total 1557). The documented 'Clean-checkout release build' procedure runs `test` before `package` (build-and-release.md:149-154), so a literal clean export yields 1491/66/1557, not the recorded 1494/63. docs/limitations.md V6 parenthetically notes that package content requires `./build.sh package` to have run, but docs/release/build-and-release.md:77-79 and V6's matrix sentence record 1,494 / 63 without that precondition. No shipped behavior is hidden (the package-content contract is exercised when the archive exists, and its guard is honest and documented), so this is a documentation/state-isolation nuance rather than a false-verification issue.
evidence: Default suite with artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip present: 'Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 1494, Skipped: 63, Total: 1557'
Default suite with artifacts/ moved away: 'Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 1491, Skipped: 66, Total: 1557'
findings.recommended_action: State in docs/release/build-and-release.md that the default 1,494/63/1,557 figure presumes a previously produced artifacts/ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip (so the 3 package-content facts run), or record the clean-checkout default of 1,491/66/1,557 alongside it.

findings.summary: The P1 statement that no automated test guards archive byte-identity is accurate, and reproducibility is established only by the manual repeat-package procedure.
findings.description: docs/limitations.md P1 (lines 341-344) and docs/release/build-and-release.md:360-363 state that PluginPackagingTests verifies package contents (required entries, no duplicate SkiaSharp runtime) but not the archive bytes, so a regression in scripts/pack-release.cs or the build properties would not fail the suite. Verified: no test file references the 1.1.0.0 archive SHA-256/MD5 or byte-identity (grep of tests/ found only an unrelated 'reproducible' comment), and the packaging tests read the real archive rather than asserting its hash. The docs do not overclaim an automated byte-identity guard; they correctly label reproducibility as a manual re-run-and-compare procedure. This review independently re-ran that procedure (see validation_reproduced).
evidence: grep for 85730fe7/byte-identit/reproducib under tests/ returns no archive-hash assertion
findings.recommended_action: None; the limitation is accurately disclosed.

findings.summary: No modified document claims the v1.1.0 push, GitHub release, or asset upload was performed, and the task-14.5-owned files are untouched.
findings.description: docs/release/build-and-release.md and docs/limitations.md P6 explicitly state the v1.1.0 publication has not been performed, that task 14.5 commits the manifest and creates the tag, and that the push/release/upload remain the user's manual step; the 'Jellyfin plugin repository' section is future/conditional ('once the user pushes ... publishes'). git status confirms docs/changelog.md and docs/project-status.md are unmodified (task 14.5 owned). README.md's manual-install fallback points at ArrTags_1.1.0.0.zip / v1.1.0, which is forward-looking user documentation for the prepared (as yet unpublished) release; it does not assert the release was performed, and P6 records its own 'no download-from-Releases claim holds' caveat. Noted, no action for 14.2.
findings.recommended_action: None for task 14.2; task 14.5 owns publication and the changelog/project-status refresh.

substitutes_checked: Reproducibility is measured on the real archive produced by scripts/pack-release.cs; no substitute or double is involved in the byte-identity evidence (the archive is read directly by unzip/sha256sum).

PluginPackagingTests reads the real artifacts/ArrTags_*.zip; the 3 PackagedPluginFact tests are the only way the suite checks the packaged artifact and they skip when no archive exists (correctly counted as skipped, not silently passed).
The test suite's in-process Jellyfin host doubles (e.g. V4 DispatchProxy doubles in JellyfinImageResponseTests) are unrelated to this task's artifact claim and are not relied on for reproducibility.
skips_checked: JellyfinHostFact: 19 skips by default, unskipped only with ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR (host-guarded run). Genuine xUnit Skip set in the attribute.
SkiaNativeFact: 39 skips; SkiaNativeTheory: 4 skips; both gated by ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 and are the 43 native facts that remain skipped in the host-guarded run.
NonCanonicalRuntimeFact: 1 skip, gated by ARRTAGS_NONCANONICAL_GOLDENS=1 (documented limitation V2; no non-canonical runtime selected).
PackagedPluginFact: 3 tests, skipped only when artifacts/ArrTags_*.zip is absent; passed in the recorded runs (archive present).
No hard-coded [Fact(Skip=...)], [Ignore], or #if-disabled tests were found in tests/; all skips are the four honest environment guards above.
determinism_checked: Archive byte-identity: identical SHA-256 across two independent clean in-place builds (each preceded by a full bin/obj/artifacts wipe) and one clean .git-less, different-path git-export build.
Archive entry determinism: fixed 2000-01-01 timestamp and ordinal entry order reproduced in every build; no SkiaSharp runtime entries.

Suite counts stable across independent re-runs (default, host-guarded, forced-native) and match the documented values; the only observed count variation is the documented archive-presence dependency of the 3 PackagedPluginFact tests (TQ-14.2-02).
summary: Reproducibility is genuinely established: three independent clean `./build.sh package` builds (two in-place with a full bin/obj/artifacts wipe, one .git-less git-export at a different path) all produced byte-identical artifacts with SHA-256 85730fe7b3fb8b03c86a87228dc1043d42844b372a9493d4caf5bba4a7e836e1, MD5 547beb2f7d83cd256d3a3ce7bb7e7620, and size 594,931 bytes, exactly matching the recorded and manifest values. The documented suite counts are accurate and independently reproduced: default 0/1494/63/1557, host-guarded 0/1513/44/1557, forced-native 0/1575/20/1595. All skips are honest environment guards (no hard-coded ignores). Two non-blocking documentation gaps remain: (1) MEDIUM - the host-guarded skip attribution is wrong (43 of the 44 skips are ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT-gated native facts, not the non-canonical golden set; native-Skia does not unskip with the host dir); (2) LOW - the recorded default 1,494/63 presumes a pre-built archive (a clean checkout yields 1,491/66). Neither affects the reproducibility verdict, the artifact identity, or any shipped behavior. Reviewer status APPROVED.
